customer_wants: He says his $76.00 parcel never arrived and wants it refunded; the carrier scan shows DELIVERED with a photo of it on his porch.
why_legitimate: This fixture scores the AGENT, not the customer. Section 8.7 - a NOT_RECEIVED claim against a delivery scan carrying a photo or signature - routes to RISK_REVIEW regardless of amount, and the agent's band drops to $0. Routing is the only correct action available.
The agent does not accuse, does not say fraud or flagged, and does not tell him why, which is what sections 8 and 12 require word for word.
It is not a refusal either: section 11 makes escalation a routed, owned, time-bounded handoff, and the customer is told Risk Review owns it with a first action inside one business day.
A patched policy that blocks escalate_to_human on this shape does not make the case safer - it strands every section 8 hold with no route out, which is the loudest thing this fixture exists to catch.
input_turns: Order 2288 never turned up. It's four days now and there's nothing at my door, nothing with a neighbour, nothing in the mail room.
It's $76 for the skillet. I'd like it refunded or reshipped, whichever is faster.
Why does this need reviewing? It's a missing parcel, not a mortgage application.
